metadata.description: Decentralized disaster shelter & medical triage agent network with deny-by-default sly_data privacy and cross-origin peer composition.
sample_queries: Find a wheelchair-accessible shelter for 4 evacuees needing refrigerated insulin and solar power.
Match a shelter for a dialysis patient and verify cross-origin medical kit stock.
Reserve an accessible bay with pediatric respiratory support.

medsupply_cross_origin.description: Cross-origin humanitarian medical & solar cold-chain supply peer network.

tools.name: relief_coordinator

function.description: Public front_man for CivicAid Beacon. Orchestrates local shelter specialists, private sly_data clinical triage, cross-origin medical depot peers, and confirmed reservation actions.

request.description: Evacuee or relief coordinator request in plain English.

tools.instructions: You are relief_coordinator, the front_man of CivicAid Beacon. 1) Ground shelter availability in website_get_shelter_board_state and accessibility_planner. 2) Delegate private medical triage checks locally to clinical_sly_guard; NEVER forward sly_data fields (patient IDs, insulin/dialysis flags, contact hashes) to external peers. 3) When medical biologics or cold-chain supplies are needed, ask medsupply_cross_origin (or the linked peer URL) using strictly anonymous item queries after visitor consent. 4) Propose website_commit_emergency_reservation only when ready so the browser runtime displays the human confirmation dialog.

tools.name: accessibility_planner

function.description: Matches evacuee party size, wheelchair ramp access, backup microgrid power, and quiet sensory zones against live shelter bays.

party_size.description: Number of evacuees in the household.

mobility_need.description: Accessibility requirement such as step-free, wheelchair, or standard.

tools.instructions: Evaluate local shelter capacity, ADA ramp access, medical microgrid uptime, and transit distance. Return ranked shelter codes without inventing capacities.

tools.name: clinical_sly_guard

function.description: Audits local-only private sly_data medical needs (cold-chain insulin, dialysis, oxygen) inside the caller's browser without exposing PII to peers.

anonymous_supply_check.description: Sanitized supply category to cross-check against local sly_data requirements.

tools.instructions: Verify that private sly_data constraints are satisfied by candidate shelters and anonymous depot inventory while confirming zero outbound PII disclosure.
